x: All four statements are correct. Google's AI data centre is planned at Visakhapatnam and Anakapalli with an investment of US$15 billion (about Rs 87,520 crore), is described as its largest AI hub outside the US, and had its groundbreaking in April 2026.

ITDC (India Tourism Development Corporation) was set up in 1966. The others are mismatched: 2002 is the year of the Incredible India campaign, Paryatan Didi was launched on 27 September 2024, and 1966 belongs to ITDC, not the Tourist Facilitator certification; Travel for LiFE is listed among the recent (2026) tourism initiatives, not a 2014 launch.

All four statements are correct. The Statue of Unity at Kevadia (Ekta Nagar), Gujarat, is dedicated to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, is 182 m tall, stands between the Satpura and Vindhya ranges, and was sculpted by Ram V. Sutar.

Only A is correct: Ahobilam has nine Narasimha shrines and is in Nandyal district. Yaganti is the Uma Maheswara temple (Nandyal), not Satyanarayana Swamy/Kakinada (that is Annavaram); Annavaram is Satyanarayana Swamy in Kakinada, while the Vayu linga is Srikalahasti (Tirupati); Simhachalam is Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha in Visakhapatnam, while Mallikarjuna is at Srisailam.

NP Kunta (the Ananthapuramu Ultra Mega Solar Park) is in Sri Sathya Sai district. Bhadla is in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, not Kurnool; Pinnapuram is the 1,680 MW pumped-storage project in Kurnool, not the Ananthapuramu solar park; Rewa solar park is in Madhya Pradesh, while Kutch has the Khavda RE park.

Pinnapuram (Kurnool, 1,680 MW) is the world's first integrated renewable-energy storage project. The other firsts are shuffled: Tarapur (1969) is the first nuclear plant, Raniganj (1774) the first coal mine, and Digboi (1889) the first oil discovery.
